evidence.summary: CASI identifies the high-power semiconductor laser laboratory at Changchun University of Science and Technology (listed by the university as 高功率半导体激光国家级重点实验室) as a national defence science and technology key laboratory, set up in 1994, whose lasers have been applied to guidance systems and smart munitions: CASI reports a beam-riding guidance laser transmitter used in a PLA main battle tank system and a laser sensor used in an Air Force terminal-sensing submunition.
